## The answer in one line

::: {.box}
Open the second terminal in 2028, not 2027. Sign a flexible lease now.
:::

- Waiting costs about 4 million euros of lost volume.
- Building early risks a 12 million euro capacity gap if demand falls short.

::: {.notes}
Say the answer first. Then the two numbers. Pause. Ask if anyone disagrees before going on.
:::

# Options and recommendation

## Leasing first keeps the choice open

| Option | Cost (EUR m) | Risk |
|--------|-------------:|------|
| Build now | 120 | High |
| Build in 2028 | 105 | Medium |
| Lease first | 40 | Low |

## Next steps

1. Agree the lease terms with the port authority.
2. Review demand again in twelve months.
3. Decide on the build in early 2028.
